result.quote: He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, for he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
result.reason: Verse 26:16 identifies Uzziah’s trespass as entering Yahweh’s temple to burn incense. The key concisely paraphrases that act; “Yahweh’s house” co-refers to the temple. His arrogance is background motivation, not a materially different answer to how he trespassed.
